text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
North Flight really is fast, huh...! Her 
next race is the Yasuda Kinen, right?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O's biggest rival...! I wonder if 
Bakushin O will be all right.

text_block_list.name: Flight Fans
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chaaannn! Congrats~~! Good luck in 
the Yasuda Kinen too!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Flight-san, you're so cool! And so 
faaast.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Bakushin O-chan... are you trembling? 
Don't tell me... are you scared?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... Bakushin O-chan seems even more 
full of life lately than usual, doesn't 
she—?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having secured a decisive victory in the 
Yomiuri Milers Cup in her best 
coordination, North Flight returned with a 
satisfied expression.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Running today really made me realize it... 
The Mile really is where I belong.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Let's carry this momentum right into the 
Yasuda Kinen...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The primary goal, the Yasuda Kinen... Just 
a little longer until the rematch with 
Sakura Bakushin O.
